Five Kuki Men Killed in Manipur Amidst Escalating Tensions

Five Kuki men were killed in Manipur within a 24-hour period, leading to escalating tensions in the region. Three of the deceased were killed in a gunfight between rival groups in Noney district. The coverage also references a brawl that reportedly sparked the Naga-Kuki conflict in Manipur.
